This mixin is intended for narrowly scoped, unlayered component styles that need to
reject generic unlayered element styles without unlayering the component's full ruleset.
CSS property names to restore.
Gates the passed content behind the live `--ig-theme` / `--ig-theme-variant`
custom properties, inside the shared components cascade layer. This is the
single source of truth for coupling any emitted CSS (tokens or structural
rules) to the runtime theme signal — anything wrapped here becomes
switchable at runtime by flipping those two custom properties, regardless
of how many themes/variants were compiled into the same stylesheet.
The target theme - material, bootstrap, fluent, indigo.
The target variant - light, dark. Omit to match any variant.

Wraps the passed content in a named cascade layer and scopes it to the given
selector through `:where()`, keeping specificity at zero. Each selector of a list
gets its own `:where()`, as Chromium can't bucket multi-argument `:where()` subjects
and would match them against every element. The active schema is yielded to the
content block so callers can resolve themes against it.
The cascade layer name (the `ig.` prefix is added by `layer`).
